title: Items left unchecked by drift's program allowlist are reported as heavy whole-suite checks, and the docstring never mentions the allowlist
goal: bl_intake's drift note reports items refused by the program allowlist (check_program_refusal with DRIFT_ALLOWS_INLINE) apart from heavy ones, e.g. in a separate field drift.refused or a distinct note, and the module docstring names the allowlist; a test named drift_refused_apart_from_heavy plants one of each; found by the SP-zihqagoi review of BG-wg7ir37i (open items with backlog.py and perfcheck.py checks are never drift-checked and the note blames a heavy test run)

run: import sys;t=open('_tools/bl_intake.py',encoding='utf-8').read();sys.exit(0 if 'drift.refused' in t or 'refused: list' in t else 1)

repro_reason: the mislabel shows only in drift's printed note over a committed check the allowlist refuses; the repro reads bl_intake for a separate refused field until the item's own test exists
